name: mydy-moodle-downloader
description: A Chrome browser extension that automatically downloads course materials from the MyDY Moodle portal

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run copy-files
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && powershell Compress-Archive -Path * -DestinationPath ../mydy-extension-v%npm_package_version%.zip -Force
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run update-manifest
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm run update-manifest
scripts.version:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm run update-manifest
scripts.prepare-release: npm run version:patch && npm run package

author: Deeptanshu Lal
